findings.message: `widgetViews` is declared but never initialised, so it is a nil map. The first `widgetViews[id]++` panics with "assignment to entry in nil map", which means every request to this handler crashes.

HTTP handlers run concurrently, and this package-level map is written without any synchronisation. Concurrent requests cause a data race and the runtime fatal error "concurrent map writes", which takes down the whole server. Guard the map with a `sync.Mutex`, preferably as a field on `Server`, or use atomic counters.

Any client-supplied integer id creates a new map entry, and nothing checks that the widget exists. An attacker can grow the map without bound by requesting arbitrary ids, exhausting memory. Validate that the widget exists before counting, or bound the map.
